Gemini 4 Neon offers fast, multi-step AI assistance

• Google DeepMind released Gemini 4 Neon, a high-capacity, low-fabrication model for enterprise tasks, on 18 Nov 2026.
• Nvidia announced it will stop shipping its H200 AI chips to China following Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO last week.
• Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 per share, valuing the company at $1.5 trillion and beginning Nasdaq trading under “ANT”.

• The model is available through the Gemini API, Google AI Studio, and the Gemini app for Pro and Ultra subscribers.
